"""Module paths and qualified names held in strings."""

import importlib
import logging
from unittest import mock

from threetears.evals.gen import EvalPrompt

LOG = logging.getLogger("threetears.evals.run.drift")
OWNER = dict(owner_module="threetears.evals.storage.routed")
PROFILE_LOGGER = "threetears.evals.kernel.host.profile"

EVAL_PROMPTS = (
    EvalPrompt(
        prompt_type="eval_proposer",
        seed_module="threetears.evals.shapes",
        constant="EVAL_PROPOSER_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT",
    ),
    EvalPrompt(prompt_type="eval_boundary_gen", seed_module="threetears.evals.shapes", constant="EVAL_BOUNDARY_GEN_TEMPLATE_DEFAULT"),
)
PROVISIONAL_NAME = ("threetears.evals.shapes", "BUDGET_SHARES")


def annotated(host: "threetears.evals.host.OpsHost") -> None:
    importlib.import_module("threetears.evals.analysis.judge_drift_read")
    with mock.patch("threetears.evals.host.run_judge_llm"):
        pass
    with mock.patch("threetears.evals.host.OpsHost.campaign_export_max_bytes", 1):
        pass


def test_setattr(monkeypatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr("threetears.evals.host.EvalHost", None)
    monkeypatch.setattr("threetears.evals.run.judge.MeteredCallLedger", None)
    harness = "threetears.evals.host:OpsHost"
    return harness
